aboutText1: Welcome to Joumonde - your destination for exclusive fashion. We combine the timeless elegance of Old Money style with relaxed casual fashion.
aboutText2: Our mission is to offer high-quality fashion for every taste - from classic sophistication to urban coolness.
ourStoryText1: Joumonde was founded in 2025 with the vision of combining timeless elegance with relaxed casual fashion. Our name unites the French "Jour" (day) with "Monde" (world) - reinterpreting the world of fashion every day.
ourStoryText2: We believe in quality, sustainability and timeless design. Each of our pieces is carefully selected and combines Old Money aesthetics with relaxed casual style.
ourMissionText1: At Joumonde, it's not just about fashion - it's about a lifestyle. We want to help people find their individual style and feel confident, whether at a business meeting or at a street festival.
ourMissionText2: Our collections are produced by the best manufacturers, with a focus on fair working conditions and sustainable materials. Premium quality for us means not only first-class fabrics, but also responsibility towards people and the environment.
premiumQualityText: High-quality materials and first-class workmanship for durable fashion pieces
sustainabilityText: Responsible production, fair working conditions and environmentally conscious material selection
customerServiceText: Personal advice, fast shipping and first-class support for a perfect shopping experience
timelessDesignText: Classic elegance meets modern trends - fashion that doesn't disappear with the season

Klassischer Blazer.description: Tailoring reinvented for modern everyday life. This blazer forgoes stiff shoulder pads and rigid interlinings to follow the natural shoulder line. The result is a jacket that is as comfortable as a cardigan, yet carries the authority of a classic bespoke suit. Made from 100% pure merino wool, it is the perfect foundation for a seamless transition from office to dinner.
features: Lightweight merino wool flannel, wearable year-round
materials: Outer fabric: 100% lightweight merino wool flannel (wearable year-round)
Construction: Unstructured (without stiff shoulder pads) for a natural silhouette
Details: Patch pockets for a more relaxed look, half lining
care: Dry cleaning recommended
Do not wash and do not tumble dry
Air out after wearing and hang on a hanger
Brush gently when needed
Smooth with steam held at a distance, do not iron directly

Polo Hemd.description: The classic, freed from loud logos. Our Polo Shirt focuses purely on cut and material quality. The specially constructed collar keeps its shape all day and doesn't fold in unattractively. A flawless fit at the shoulders and arms makes this polo the first choice for a smart, effortless appearance.
features: Tightly woven piqué cotton or fine merino knit
Flawless fit at shoulders and arms
materials: Outer fabric: Tightly woven piqué cotton or fine merino knit
Collar: Seamless one-piece collar for an elegant stand
Branding: Invisible luxury, no embroidered logo on the chest
care: Piqué cotton: machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Merino knit: wool cycle and dry flat
Do not tumble dry
Iron on low to medium heat

Knit Zip-Polo.description: The modern interpretation of the "Old Money" aesthetic. The Knit Zip-Polo bridges the formality of a shirt and the comfort of a sweater. Made from extra-fine merino wool, it offers a clean, structured silhouette that adapts to your body temperature. The distinctive metal zip sets a cool, architectural accent. The ideal piece for the office, the evening and everything in between.
materials: Outer fabric: 100% extra-fine merino wool (breathable and temperature-regulating)
Hardware: YKK 1/4 metal zip in matte silver/gunmetal finish
Collar: Structured, shape-retaining fine-knit polo collar
Branding: Tone-on-tone Joumonde embroidery, 3 cm above the left sleeve cuff
care: Wool cycle at 30°C with wool detergent
Close the zip and wash inside out
Dry flat
Do not tumble dry
Do not bleach
Iron on low heat

Bundfalthose.description: The bridge between traditional tailoring and modern casual chic. The double pleat gives these trousers not only a distinctive, classic character, but also exceptional freedom of movement. Thanks to the metal side adjusters, the waist always fits perfectly, no belt needed. A design that shows posture.
features: Side adjusters instead of a belt
Heavy cotton twill or fine virgin wool
materials: Outer fabric: Heavy, tightly woven cotton twill or fine virgin wool
Waist: Side adjusters (side buckles for width regulation), no belt needed
Cut: Double pleat for more volume at the thigh, elegantly tapering downward
care: Virgin wool: dry clean
Cotton twill: machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Do not tumble dry, hang to dry
Iron with steam or on medium heat, reshape the pleats

Elegante Weste.description: The ultimate layering piece. This waistcoat brings architectural structure to any outfit. Worn under the matching blazer, it completes the sartorial look; over a simple Oxford shirt or T-shirt, it becomes a stylish statement in its own right. The adjustable cupro strap at the back guarantees a razor-sharp, tailored fit.
features: Merino wool flannel, matching the blazer
materials: Front fabric: 100% merino wool flannel (an exact match to the blazer)
Back panel: 100% cupro with adjustable strap and solid metal buckle
Buttons: Color-matched horn buttons
care: Dry cleaning recommended
Do not wash and do not tumble dry
Hang on a hanger
Do not bleach
Iron on low heat with a cloth in between

Quarter Zipper.description: The sporty side of the "Old Money" lifestyle. The Quarter Zipper combines the comfort of heavy French terry with a sharp, architectural collar. The distinctive metal zip and the refined leather puller add tactile accents that set this piece apart from ordinary loungewear. Perfect over a T-shirt or shirt.
materials: Outer fabric: 450 g/m² heavyweight French terry cotton
Hardware: YKK 1/4 metal zip with genuine leather puller
Collar: Shape-retaining stand collar with smooth inside
care: Machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Close the zip and keep the leather puller away from moisture
Hang or dry flat, do not tumble dry
Iron on low heat

Strickpullover.description: Heavy, structured and uncompromisingly high quality. This knit sweater is designed for colder days and offers a firm, masculine drape. The voluminous rib texture gives the piece incredible depth and feel, while the heavy yarn blend insulates body warmth perfectly. A sweater that feels like a protective armor of pure comfort.
materials: Outer fabric: Heavyweight cotton-merino blend (scratch-free, heavy and shape-retaining)
Texture: Distinctive, chunky knit pattern (e.g. fisherman's rib)
Cuffs: Reinforced rib cuffs that don't stretch out
care: Wool cycle at 30°C with wool detergent, inside out
Do not wring
Dry flat, do not hang
Do not tumble dry
Do not iron directly, smooth with steam held at a distance if needed

Leinenhose.description: Relaxed without compromising on aesthetics. Made from heavy, breathable linen, these trousers are the perfect answer to warm temperatures. The fabric has been gently pre-washed to guarantee instant softness and the characteristic, relaxed "Quiet Luxury" drape. Perfect with loafers and a loose shirt.
features: Concealed button fly with genuine horn buttons
materials: Outer fabric: 100% heavy, pre-washed linen (wrinkles nobly, never restlessly)
Closure: Concealed button fly with genuine horn buttons
Cut: Relaxed straight leg for maximum air circulation
care: Machine wash at 30°C on a gentle cycle
Wash with similar colors
Hang to dry, do not tumble dry
Linen is meant to wrinkle, iron damp on high heat if needed

Oversized Hoodie.description: The ultimate heavyweight hoodie. We took the classic hooded sweatshirt and raised every detail to a premium level. The 450-gram fabric gives a perfect, slightly boxy drape. The double-layered hood sits voluminously at the neck, and the soft waffle-knit lining in the kangaroo pocket is a detail of pure craftsmanship that only the wearer feels.
materials: Outer fabric: 450 g/m² heavyweight French terry cotton
Hood: Double-layered for a solid, well-shaped stand at the neck
Details: Inside of the kangaroo pocket in soft waffle knit
care: Machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Wash with similar colors
Tumble dry on low heat or hang to dry
Iron on low heat

T-Shirt.description: The perfect T-shirt exists. We have ended the hunt for the ideal basic. At 250 g/m², this T-shirt falls heavy and structured, shows nothing through, and keeps its exact shape even after countless washes. The snug, robust collar frames the face perfectly. Not an undershirt, but a statement piece in its own right.
features: Snug rib collar that doesn't stretch out
Tubular knit without disruptive side seams
materials: Outer fabric: 250 g/m² heavyweight jersey cotton (completely opaque)
Collar: Tightly woven, snug rib collar that doesn't stretch out
Construction: Tubular knit without disruptive side seams
care: Machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Wash with similar colors
Tumble dry on low heat or hang to dry
Iron on medium heat

Cargo Pants.description: Utility design meets tailored elegance. These Cargo Pants free the classic workwear look from unnecessary volume. The heavy cotton twill gives a perfect, straight drape, while the flat, concealed pockets offer maximum functionality with a razor-sharp silhouette. Trousers that don't shout for attention, but immediately show that absolute structure and premium craftsmanship matter.
features: Concealed YKK zips on the pockets
Straight leg with slightly tapered hem
materials: Outer fabric: Heavy 100% cotton twill (heavyweight cotton twill, approx. 350 g/m²)
Hardware: Concealed YKK zips on the pockets, sturdy metal button at the waist
Pockets: Seam-integrated, flat cargo pockets without bulky flaps for a reduced silhouette
Cut: Straight leg with slightly tapered hem
care: Machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Close zips and button before washing
Wash with similar colors
Tumble dry on low heat or hang to dry
Iron on medium heat

Kaschmirpullover.description: A masterpiece of understatement. This sweater is knitted from the finest two-ply cashmere, combining incomparable softness with robust durability. The cut is relaxed yet precise, designed to drape elegantly over an Oxford shirt or casually with pleated trousers. An uncompromising investment piece that only gains character over the years. No visible logos, just tangible luxury.
materials: Outer fabric: 100% pure two-ply Mongolian cashmere (2-ply yarn for maximum durability and minimal pilling)
Cuffs: Shape-retaining, finely ribbed trims on sleeves and hem
Branding: Scratch-free Joumonde soft print at the neck, no visible exterior logos
care: Hand wash at 20°C or wool cycle with mild wool detergent
Do not wring, only press out water gently
Dry flat on a towel
Do not tumble dry
Do not bleach
Iron on low heat without steam

Oxford Hemd.description: The unshakable foundation of every wardrobe. Our Oxford shirt is made from thick Supima cotton that is opaque and gets softer with every wash without losing its shape. The characteristic button-down collar rolls in a perfect arc around the neck, while the genuine mother-of-pearl buttons add a subtle but unmistakable touch of luxury.
features: Button-down collar with a perfect roll
materials: Outer fabric: Heavy, textured Supima Oxford weave (100% cotton)
Collar: Classic button-down collar with a perfect "roll"
Buttons: Thick, shimmering mother-of-pearl buttons
care: Machine wash at 40°C
Close buttons before washing
Tumble dry on low heat or hang to dry
Do not bleach
Iron slightly damp on high heat

Wollmantel.description: A coat that outlasts generations. Thanks to its high cashmere content, this wool coat offers incomparable thermal insulation with a soft, elegant drape. The cut is timeless and structured, with a classic lapel that underlines formal outfits and instantly elevates casual looks. True craftsmanship shows in the details: from the genuine horn buttons to the flowing cupro lining. An absolute statement of understated elegance.
materials: Outer fabric: 80% heavy virgin wool, 20% cashmere for a flowing, soft drape
Lining: 100% breathable cupro (silky feel, prevents static)
Hardware: Genuine dark horn buttons with subtle grain
care: Dry clean only
Do not wash and do not tumble dry
Air out after wearing and hang on a wide hanger
Brush gently when needed
Smooth creases with steam held at a distance, do not iron directly

Ledergürtel.description: An accessory made not for a season, but for a lifetime. Crafted from uncompromising vegetable-tanned full-grain leather, this belt develops a unique, personal patina with every wear. The heavy, brushed brass buckle underlines the purist "Quiet Luxury" approach. No peeling faux leather, no cheap fittings, just honest, solid craftsmanship that instantly elevates any outfit.
materials: Main material: 100% vegetable-tanned full-grain leather
Buckle: Solid, brushed brass
Finish: Hand-polished and waxed edges, no glued layers
care: Do not wash
Wipe with a dry, soft cloth
Occasionally treat with colorless leather balm
Protect from moisture, heat and direct sunlight
Polish the brass buckle with a dry cloth

Trainerhose.description: Loungewear that dominates the room. These sweatpants are made from the same heavy fabric as our signature hoodie. Thanks to the weight of the cotton, they fall extremely straight and clean, without bagging at the knees. The thick drawcords with heavy brass tips elevate the design, so the pants look great not only on the couch but also on the street.
features: Thick cotton drawcords with brass tips
materials: Outer fabric: 450 g/m² heavyweight French terry (matching the hoodie)
Drawcords: Twisted, thick cotton cords with solid brass tips
Cuffs: Wide, elastic rib cuffs at the hem
care: Machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Wash with similar colors
Tumble dry on low heat or hang to dry
Iron on low heat

Jeans.description: Authentic denim craftsmanship in its purest form. These jeans deliberately forgo artificial elastane and rely on genuine, heavy selvedge denim that adapts perfectly to your body and movements over time. A straight, uncompromising cut that forms an extremely clean silhouette. Jeans you have to break in, only to never want to take them off again.
materials: Outer fabric: 12.5 oz rigid selvedge denim (100% cotton, no artificial stretch)
Wash: Gentle rinse wash (softened, but deep in color)
Hardware: Solid copper rivets and engraved metal button
care: Machine wash at 30°C, inside out
Wash separately the first few times, as selvedge denim may bleed
Wash as rarely as possible to preserve color and fit
Do not tumble dry, hang to dry
Iron on medium heat
